  • Announcement on Crackdown Against Unofficial Trading and Recovery of Illegal Items

    Dear Wanderers: Recently, we have found that some rule-breaking players use gimmicks such as "low-price discounted gifts" to lure others into unofficial trades, and then engage in fraudulent activities through malicious black-market tactics. Such actions not only severely undermine the fair environment of the game, but also cause unsuspecting players to suffer actual losses — after paying money offline, their game items are reclaimed by the system due to the sellers' violations.

  • [Across Autumn Waters] Version 2.4 Update Overview

    Dear Wanderer, The Eastwind Pavilion will undergo a live update on November 13, 2026, from 18:00:00 to 22:59:59 (UTC+8). You can remain logged in and continue playing as usual, although some features and game modes may be temporarily unavailable. Please note that the maintenance period may end early or be extended depending on server conditions. Plan your playtime accordingly, and thank you for your understanding and support!

  • Version 2.4 Path Balance Adjustment Announcement (November 13)

    Dear Wanderers: These path experience and balance improvements are based on real-time data and player feedback. While ensuring the stability of the path experience, we have focused our adjustments on paths whose data performance fell short of expectations and where gameplay experience still had room for improvement.

  • Version 2.4 Dev Letter | In Times of Turmoil, What Makes a True Hero?

    As Where Winds Meet marks its first global anniversary, we invite Wanderers to journey back sixteen years and witness a battle that reshaped the realm. Along the Hutuo River, the 200,000-strong army of the Later Jin stood locked in a tense standoff against the Khitan forces. The outcome of the Battle of Zhongdu Bridge not only sealed the fate of the Later Jin dynasty, but also marked a pivotal turning point throughout the history of the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms.
